narrative.intro: Leidos Biomedical Research obligated $303M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Leidos Biomedical Research won 105 awards in the period, with an average award size of $2.9M, and obligations are down 45.9% year over year. Leidos Biomedical Research recorded obligations of $935M in FY21, $982M in FY22, $1.2B in FY23, $869M in FY24, $560M in FY25, and $303M in FY26. Leidos Biomedical Research shows Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) as a top NAICS market at $305M. The current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date) and the page notes that figures are contract obligations except where award-value is specified in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. These figures place FY2026 to date well below recent peak years, and they reflect the fiscal-year-to-date snapshot provided on the vendor page.

sections.heading: What changed in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Leidos Biomedical Research obligated $303M in FY2026 to date, down 45.9% year over year. Leidos Biomedical Research won 105 awards in the period, with an average award size of $2.9M. Leidos Biomedical Research previously recorded $560M in FY25 and $1.2B in FY23, showing a decline into FY26.

sections.heading: Where do Leidos Biomedical Research obligations come from?
sections.body: Leidos Biomedical Research records $305M in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology). Leidos Biomedical Research also reports obligations in Facilities Support Services, without a listed dollar total on this page. The FY21 through FY26 series shows multi-year obligation totals that contextualize current-year activity.
